## Linked Issue

Refs #3601

## Scope Summary

- Bind the original scheduler fixture to the canonical ESM materializer runtime assets, preserving allowed roots, source/fixture isolation, regular-file checks and repeated missing/symlink refusal even when existing fixture bytes match.
- Provision the literal locked schema validator through integrity-checked cached packages and a private offline install. Track real installed bytes before fixture admission; retain schema refusal, cold/corrupt-cache refusal, linked destination/source refusal, cleanup and post-admission byte drift controls.
- Consume only the exact applicable canonical roster source increments supplied by #3521 (fae117436a4c829748c04c6381d86db6be764e76 and 40d9774b3bab7e21b845984eff7e963d5c832c52). Preserve complete-roster byte equality and all first-attempt, owner, replay and temporal gates. Update current documentation to match that supplied source behavior.
- Generate this candidate's authority with the unchanged original producer and actual local inputs, then verify the producer's fixed point at the published candidate. Neither the supplier's generated bytes nor receipt identity are copied. Existing frozen review candidates remain unchanged.
